Aberdeen Archives, Gallery and Museums · Wun Yo Maru ship record

note: JACAR identifies Un’yō and the 1875 Ganghwa engagement. Aberdeen’s ship register describes Wun Yo Maru as a two-masted, brig-rigged screw steamship. The small steam gunboat is a machinery-and-hull analogy, not the exact brig rig or gun arrangement. This anonymous ship illustration does not reconstruct the Korean shore defenses, landing party, strength or losses.
